Subject: Problem with body check

Hi!

I am filtering spam mails with "body_checks" directive in main.cf. In 
relative file, I filter some mails if they contains a certain character 
chain (for example: http://blablabla.com). Doing it, I am not accepting 
several spam mails, but I have notice a problem: when during night 
logwatch runs, it scans all log messages and it finds the chain 
"http://blablabla.com" in the mail.log. Logwatchs generate the log mail, 
but this mail also contains the chain and postifx also does a reject.

Is there any way for filter with "body_checks" a chain but allow mails 
from localhost//root (logwatch mails to root) ???

Thanks.
